typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	dStartPreviousMonth as timestamp (toTimestamp('6/1/2021')),
	sRecordStatus as string ('PR'),
	sVitolDefault as string ('Post To GL'),
	OleDBtoReconControl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		effDate as timestamp,
		PACCT as string,
		PATFE1 as string,
		PATFE2 as string,
		PCALC as string,
		PCLASS as string,
		PCMNT1 as string,
		PCTYM as string,
		PEXCH as string,
		PFC as string,
		PGIVF as string,
		PGIVIO as string,
		POFFIC as string,
		PRECID as string,
		PSDSC1 as string,
		PSNAME as string,
		PSPRED as string,
		PSTYPE as string,
		PSUBCL as string,
		PSUBTY as string,
		PTTYPE as string,
		PTYPE as string,
		PUSER as string,
		PTDATE as timestamp,
		PTPRIC as decimal(38,8),
		PFEE1 as decimal(38,8),
		PFEE2 as decimal(38,8),
		total_fee as decimal(38,8),
		PQTY as decimal(38,8),
		AU_Number as string,
		PFIRM as string,
		PCOMM as decimal(38,8),
		PFEE3 as decimal(38,8),
		PATCOM as string,
		PFEE4 as decimal(38,8)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OleDBfromST4A
OleDBfromST4A derive(RiskEOM = $dStartPreviousMonth,
		dCreateDte = currentTimestamp(),
		sStatus = toString($sRecordStatus),
		sType = toString((iif(PRECID == 'A', 'ADJ', 'TRADE'))),
		sGMI = toString((POFFIC + PACCT)),
		RisEOMDef = $dStartPreviousMonth,
		sCCYRef = toString((PATCOM)),
		sVitolDefault = toString($sVitolDefault)) ~> CalculateFields
OleDBfromST4A aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> ST4RowCount0
CalculateFields sink(input(
		VITOL as string,
		PATCOM as string,
		PSTYPE as string,
		PGIVIO as string,
		PTYPE as string,
		PSUBCL as string,
		AU_Number as string,
		riskMonth_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PFIRM as string,
		Record_Status as string,
		PFC as string,
		PATFE2 as string,
		PATFE1 as string,
		effDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PCTYM as string,
		create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PFEE1 as double,
		PUSER as string,
		PFEE2 as double,
		PSDSC1 as string,
		PFEE3 as double,
		PFEE4 as double,
		CCY_CODE as string,
		PCOMM as double,
		PRECID as string,
		PSPRED as string,
		PCLASS as string,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PEXCH as string,
		PCALC as string,
		PQTY as integer,
		POFFIC as string,
		Total_fee as double,
		PACCT as string,
		GMI_ACCNT as string,
		PCMNT1 as string,
		PSUBTY as string,
		PTPRIC as double,
		PGIVF as string,
		PTDATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Type as string,
		PTTYPE as string,
		PSNAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		VITOL = sVitolDefault,
		PATCOM,
		PSTYPE,
		PGIVIO,
		PTYPE,
		PSUBCL,
		AU_Number,
		riskMonth_Dte = RiskEOM,
		PFIRM,
		Record_Status = sStatus,
		PFC,
		PATFE2,
		PATFE1,
		effDate,
		PCTYM,
		create_Dte = dCreateDte,
		PFEE1,
		PUSER,
		PFEE2,
		PSDSC1,
		PFEE3,
		PFEE4,
		CCY_CODE = sCCYRef,
		PCOMM,
		PRECID,
		PSPRED,
		PCLASS,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte = RisEOMDef,
		PEXCH,
		PCALC,
		PQTY,
		POFFIC,
		Total_fee = total_fee,
		PACCT,
		GMI_ACCNT = sGMI,
		PCMNT1,
		PSUBTY,
		PTPRIC,
		PGIVF,
		PTDATE,
		Type = sType,
		PTTYPE,
		PSNAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OleDBtoReconControl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OleDBtoReconControl
ST4RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> ST4RowCountCACHESINK
